atoms.text: The secure base: a child explores the world only because a caregiver waits to receive them, so courage depends on a place to return.
The responsiveness test: an infant's attachment style is shaped by how reliably an adult answers distress, so love is measured in latency.
The internal working model: early care becomes a template for adult relationships, so the past is a script the present keeps performing.
The avoidant child: a neglected infant learns not to signal need, so self-sufficiency is a scar rather than a virtue.
The anxious attachment: a child who cannot predict care clings and tests, so love is experienced as a supply that might run out.
The separation protest: removing the attachment figure triggers panic and grief, so loss is a behavioral emergency before it is an emotion.
The disorganized child: a caregiver is both refuge and threat, so the child has no strategy for safety.
The stranger situation: a controlled separation experiment reveals attachment style, so a laboratory stages the smallest possible abandonment.
The adult attachment: romantic partners reproduce infant patterns, so a lover is treated like a parent and resents it.
The replacement caregiver: a new figure is introduced after loss and must earn trust, so recovery is a relationship with a deadline.
The mother-blaming critique: a theory that emphasizes maternal influence is accused of ignoring culture and genes, so the story's science is also its ideology.
The child who cannot be soothed: no intervention works, so the caregiver's competence is undermined by a mismatch no one can name.
The institution without a primary figure: an orphanage rotates staff, so children fail to attach to anyone and the system calls it a disorder.
The therapy that repairs: a clinician offers a consistent, responsive relationship, so treatment is a second childhood.
The pet as attachment figure: a person relies on an animal for comfort, so the theory's logic extends to nonhuman bonds.
The pattern that repeats: a character swears not to repeat their parent's mistakes and does, so the working model is stronger than resolve.
